template.title: The Plant Doctor's Song
template.summary: A kind child helps a sad plant feel better with fun experiments, water, light, and a special song.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] looked at the plant on the windowsill and felt a little sad.
The [[slot_plant]] had drooping leaves and seemed thirsty.
[[slot_child]] decided to try a funny cure, so [[slot_cure_action]] to the plant.
Then [[slot_child]] played a soft [[slot_music_type]] with the plant.
The next day, [[slot_child]] noticed the soil was dry and the sun was hidden by clouds.
[[slot_child]] poured water into the pot and moved the plant to a sunny spot.
The centerpiece moment: [[slot_child]] put headphones on the pot so the plant could listen to their favorite song.
After the water and light, the [[slot_plant]] perked up and showed a [[slot_change]].
[[slot_child]] smiled, happy that the plant was no longer sad.
The window sill felt brighter, and both [[slot_child]] and the plant enjoyed the sunshine together.
